title: Hoodlum Soldier Ep 17: Daddy

scenes.say: The best title he ever earned wasn't sergeant. It was Daddy.
scenes.visual: a man's large hand holding a baby's tiny hand, close up, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: He swore his kids would never see the block the way he saw it.
scenes.visual: a child's bedroom with posters and a night light, peaceful, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: He's at every game. Every recital. Every parent conference.
scenes.visual: a father in the bleachers at a youth basketball game, seen from behind, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: He teaches his son a jump shot and a firm handshake.
scenes.visual: a father and son on an outdoor basketball court at sunset, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: He teaches his daughter she never needs anyone's permission to be great.
scenes.visual: a father and daughter walking hand in hand down a sunny sidewalk, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Some nights, the ghosts still visit.
scenes.visual: a man sitting on the edge of a bed at night, head in his hands, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Now little feet run in and climb into his lap.
scenes.visual: small children climbing onto a man on a couch, warm lamp light, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: They don't know they're healing him.
scenes.visual: a child asleep on a father's chest, soft morning light, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Breaking the cycle isn't a speech. It's showing up every day.
scenes.visual: a father packing school lunches in an early morning kitchen, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: His legacy has a bedtime and a homework folder.
scenes.visual: a homework folder and a bedtime story book on a kitchen table, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Follow for Episode Eighteen. Turn negative into positive.
scenes.visual: kids' sneakers lined up by a front door, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

caption: HOODLUM SOLDIER, Episode 17 of 25: Daddy. The true-story series from the book by Elvin Torres Sr. New episode every 48 hours.
